hook: Mumbai chase Hyderabad's *172* in just 13.1 overs
hook_b: Mumbai chase Hyderabad's *172* in just 13.1 overs
tldr: Mumbai beat Hyderabad by seven wickets in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy first round at Kolkata.

beats.what: Hyderabad were all out for 172 in 20 overs (M Abhirath Reddy 35); Mumbai made 174/3 in 13.1 overs.
beats.why: It is Hyderabad's opening game of India's domestic T20 tournament.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Hyderabad women's U-23 side also lost, all out for 68 against Maharashtra in Raipur.

cards.q: Can Hyderabad bounce back in the next game?

qs: Was 172 below par at the Kolkata venue?
Who replaces the top order if changes come?

facts.t: Hyderabad's women's U-23 team was bowled out for *68* by Maharashtra the same day.

viz.verdict: Mumbai needed far fewer overs; a heavy loss for Hyderabad

watch: Hyderabad's next Mushtaq Ali Trophy match.
